wrap_model: wrap a PyTorch model with optional L2 normalization and multi-scale inference wrappers
extract_features: extract features from a dataset using a model with distributed data loading and gathering
evaluate: run evaluation on a model with postprocessors, metrics, and optional result accumulation
save_features_dict: save a dictionary of feature tensors to a .pt or .npy file on disk
average_metrics: compute the mean and standard deviation across a list of evaluation metrics dictionaries
